Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (53 points, ~3% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.29), which favours a robust combination.
